slides.sub: Most trail races are lost on the descents.

slides.title: Shorter steps
slides.head: Take quick, short steps instead of long bounds.
slides.body: A shorter stride lands softer and puts less load on your quads.

slides.title: Stay tall
slides.head: Lean with the slope, not back against it.
slides.body: Leaning back means braking with every step. Stay relaxed and let gravity help.

slides.title: Look ahead
slides.head: Look five metres up the trail, not at your feet.
slides.body: Your feet find the rocks faster when your eyes are already planning the line.

slides.title: Use your arms
slides.head: Let your arms out for balance.
slides.body: Loose arms keep you steady on loose ground and stop you tensing up.

slides.title: Practise downhill
slides.head: Add a few downhill repeats to your week.
slides.body: Quads adapt to downhill running when you build it up gradually.
